column1: # Marksage intent test set v1 — written by Pablo, frozen before any training (ROADMAP §0.3).
# Columns (tab-separated): lang, id, query, src. Fill in the query column the way you would type it in ⌘K:
# short forms, typos and slang welcome. src: "written" (made up for this set) or "real" (something you typed or
# would type). Add rows freely; rows left without a query are skipped. "none" = something the palette can't do.
# Don't look at the registry's search words or the training phrases: this set measures your words, not ours.
# sample — Try it on a sample document / Testar com um documento de exemplo
# pdf — Save as PDF / Salvar como PDF
# edit-table — Lines to a table (tabs, columns or commas) / Linhas em tabela (tabs, colunas ou vírgulas)
# edit-bullets — Bulleted list / Lista com marcadores
# edit-tasks — Task list / Lista de tarefas
# edit-heading-up — Heading one level up (## → #) / Título um nível acima (## → #)
# edit-heading-down — Heading one level down (# → ##) / Título um nível abaixo (# → ##)
# edit-code — Code block / Bloco de código
# edit-plain — Remove formatting (bold, italic, links…) / Remover formatação (negrito, itálico, links…)
# outline — Show the Outline / Mostrar a Estrutura
# theme — Switch to dark theme / Mudar para o tema escuro
# assist-model — Assist: Rules + AI / Assist: Regras + IA
# about — About Marksage / Sobre o Marksage
# docs — How Smart Assist works / Como o Smart Assist funciona
# models — How the models work / Como os modelos funcionam
# story — The story: decisions and models / A história: decisões e modelos
# privacy — Privacy & storage / Privacidade e armazenamento
# none — something the palette can't do (make bold, insert an image, undo, translate…)
